notes: Venus is modeled as non-custodial DeFi lending rather than a platform-owned account balance. Non-custodial custody does not eliminate economic and protocol risk: the 2021 shortfall exposed collateral-price/liquidation risk, while the 2026 THE incident demonstrated that direct-token donation, supply-cap enforcement gaps, thin-liquidity collateral and oracle-price behavior can combine to create protocol bad debt even without platform custody of user balances.
